scientific_integrity: Explicit full-subset enumeration, complete acyclic matching tests and exact integral unimodular minor calculations are bundled with an independently implemented second Morse differential evaluation. The work is not independently audited; publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the line-avoiding complexes of the two isomorphism classes of order-thirteen Steiner triple systems; neither higher orders nor equivariant homotopy is asserted. External classification of the two design types is used, not reproved.
title: Homotopy classification of the two thirteen-point Steiner line-avoiding complexes
